tagline: Aras Kargo, Yurtiçi Kargo and Geliver for Shipping Connect: Turkish checkout methods, labels with desi and cash on delivery, tracking in the customer account and cancelling, straight from your Magento admin.
key_features: Aras Kargo, Yurtiçi Kargo and Geliver connections
Geliver reaches Aras, Yurtiçi, PTT, Sürat, HepsiJet and Kolay Gelsin
Checkout methods with flat, weight or subtotal prices
Labels with desi, weight and parcel count
Cash on delivery as cash or card (Aras, Yurtiçi)
Il and ilçe from the address, plate codes filled automatically
Tracking events in the admin and in My Account

benefits.title: Labels without the carrier portal
benefits.text: Create the label and the Magento shipment with its tracking number from the order view, or for up to 50 orders at once from the order grid.

benefits.title: Customers see where their parcel is
benefits.text: A cron job reads the carrier's tracking, stores the status, events and delivery date and shows them on the customer's order page on Luma and Hyvä.

benefits.title: Turkish addresses handled
benefits.text: State/Province is sent as the province (il) and City as the district (ilçe); the province plate code is added for the carriers that need it.

showcase.label: Checkout
showcase.title: Turkish carriers for Turkish addresses
showcase.text: Each connection offers its own checkout methods with a flat price, a weight or subtotal table, free shipping from a subtotal and allowed countries, for example TR only.

showcase.label: My Account
showcase.title: Tracking on the customer's order page
showcase.text: The order page shows the carrier, the tracking number with a link to the carrier's tracking page, a four-step progress bar and the latest tracking events.

showcase.label: Connections
showcase.title: One connection per carrier account
showcase.text: Credentials are stored encrypted, the form says where they come from, and Test Connection checks them before you switch the connection on.

showcase.label: Labels
showcase.title: Desi, weight and cash on delivery
showcase.text: The label form shows the desi of the parcels, takes the cash on delivery amount (pre-filled for COD payment methods) and creates the Magento shipment with the tracking number.

showcase.label: Tracking
showcase.title: Every event on the label page
showcase.text: Status, tracking number and the carrier's events with time and location. Update Tracking checks now; Cancel cancels the shipment at the carrier.

feature_groups.title: Carriers
items: Aras Kargo: order, label, cash on delivery and cancel tested on the Aras test web service; tracking beta
Yurtiçi Kargo (beta): createShipment, queryShipment, cancelShipment; the module prints the label with your cargo key as a Code 128 barcode
Geliver (beta): cheapest offer or a fixed carrier service code, PDF label from the chosen carrier, return labels
Several connections per carrier, for example one per website

feature_groups.title: Labels
items: Desi shown for the parcels in the label form
Cash on delivery collected as cash or card (Aras, Yurtiçi)
Parcel count on one label (Yurtiçi), one parcel per label (Aras, Geliver)
Mass action for up to 50 orders, one merged PDF
Cancel at the carrier from the label page

feature_groups.title: Checkout and tracking
items: Flat, weight table, subtotal table prices and free shipping from a subtotal
Tracking by cron with status, events and delivery date
Tracking on the customer's order page (Luma and Hyvä)
Optional order status and customer e-mails on delivery milestones

feature_groups.title: Admin and developers
items: Test mode and live per connection
Credentials stored encrypted; disabled connections are never called
API log with passwords and tokens masked
CLI: test connection, create labels, update tracking
